_comment: Desktop update-manifest policy (change: add-desktop-auto-update). Read by the release workflow's `manifest` job, NOT by the app.
_min_supported_version: Clients strictly below this are shown a BLOCKING forced-update screen. Raise it only when an older client genuinely cannot talk to the backend any more — it is a one-way door for everyone below it. Empty string = no floor.
_channel: Release channel the manifest is published under.
_key_id: Which trusted key CI signs with. Must be present in the app's compiled-in key set AND in the backend's CYMBRA_UPDATE_TRUSTED_KEYS.
